data: Which relation links the 'WORD' to chunks?

The question asks which relation links the 'WORD' to chunks. From the caption and the figure, we can see two types of relations: 'appears-in-case' and 'super'. The 'appears-in-case' relation connects the 'WORD' to the chunks within each case. Therefore, the relation linking the 'WORD' to chunks is 'appears-in-case'.
